claims.statement: Pinned filtering guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and narrows project views/charts using item metadata/custom fields. Results are scoped display, not full project inventory, access control or semantic acceptance.

Distinct field qualifiers combine AND; comma values for one qualifier combine OR; repeating same qualifier demands all values. OR across different fields is not supported by pinned source; no arbitrary Boolean parser inferred.

Hyphen negates filters/comma combinations; has tests populated values and no tests missing values, with -no returning populated. View support for negated no differs from auto-add qualifier subset; do not reuse view grammar in automation blindly.

Adding an item while a view is filtered applies filtered metadata to new item, illustrated with Status. Filter use can influence writes; source does not fully specify unsupported/negative/compound initialization or write permission handling.

Assignee/label/custom/reviewer/milestone qualifiers are described; reviewer prose says reviewed by user while no:reviewers says no reviewer. Assigned reviewer, submitted review and approval state remain distinct pending native semantics.

repo qualifier selects owner/repository; is states open/closed/merged and types issue/pr/draft includes both draft issue and draft PR. Close reason completed/not planned/reopened is source state, not independent acceptance.

Updated examples use greater-than @today-minus-age while prose says seven/thirty or more days ago, opposite ordinary date comparator interpretation. Preserve explicit unresolved contradiction; introductory last-updated:5days differs from updated syntax.

Update reusable includes creation/reopen/edit/comment/label/assignment/milestone/transfer, so absence of code changes is not inactivity. Project-field effects from auto-archive review need scope reconciliation, not assumed identical.

Number/date/iteration comparisons support > >= < <=; dates YYYY-MM-DD, ranges inclusive with wildcard endpoints. Named iteration ordering requires native configuration, not string sort or invented numeric limits.

@me binds signed-in reader, @current/@previous/@next bind iteration context and @today current day; keyword offsets/ranges supported. Timezone/gaps/overlaps and authenticated identity must be captured for reproducible assessment.

Field-qualified text matches exact value while unqualified text matches word beginnings across titles/text fields; quoted text handles spaces/special characters. Case, normalization and escaping implementation remain unverified.

Wildcard text feature resolves FPT/GHEC only, not GHES at pinned commit; contains/prefix/suffix examples cannot establish GHES support. Numeric range wildcard is separately documented outside conditional.

Issue-type filtering depends on organizational taxonomy; parent filter uses full owner/repo/issue identity and does not establish transitive hierarchy coverage. Missing/inaccessible metadata cannot become passing absence.

Full guide, last-updated reusable and wildcard feature reviewed. No filter saved, items created or upstream procedures executed; all claims reference-only, no accepted policy, rights clearance or native receipt.
